start_here: Say to your AI: "Find the Claude Cloud accounts already signed in on my server, list their existing sessions, then inspect the unfinished ones before sending each a continuation brief." Do not launch replacements for work with an active owner.
no_lists_because: The existing Claude Cloud sessions live with the authenticated Claude account, not in a new Trillion list. This operation reads and resumes them in place without copying their credentials.
instructions: 1. Find the owner computer with authenticated Claude Code config folders already present; call accounts to discover those names, not credentials.
2. Call list for each config folder, then read for candidate sessions to identify the exact unfinished task, last commit, existing session id and any blocked questions.

3. Check that the existing session is not still actively writing and that no other agent owns the same work before sending a continuation. For a proposed new session, use dry_run first and verify no existing owner.
4. Call resume for the exact config folder and session id with the next verified instruction; never use start as an automatic fallback on errors.
5. Read the session again and verify a new message was accepted and real work progressed. A successful tool call alone does not prove task completion.
